title: 第23章 大军压境第24章 开始攻城了
slug: 饥荒年我囤货娇养了古代大将军
lines: 将军府传出有粮食的传闻，今天领粥的都能分到一片清甜西瓜。
赵有财更加确定，将军府内有大量粮食！
魏广在蛮族大军南下之前，是镇关有名的混混头子，他在巡防营里有过命交情的兄弟。
在镇关街上，他算黑白两道都有人。
平日里在店家吃食，不用付钱。
有生意好的店主动缴纳保护费，以免遇到地痞流氓在店子里撒野。
魏广收了钱，肯定会办事，但凡吃饭不给钱的，他会让人拖出去打一顿。
他虽混，还算讲道义。
赵有财之所以非魏广不可，因为魏广曾经被镇关驻守通缉过。
他知道镇关通向外面的秘道，所以从来没被抓到。
赵有财想向外面传递消息，想引蛮族从密道进入镇关，攻击将军府抢粮……
他为了钱财，全城百姓的命不顾。
他想抢了将军府，这辈子，下辈子，祖孙世代都有数之不尽的财富。
华夏干涸，六国都没有收成。
有了这批粮，他能收割天下财富。
所以才如此疯狂，不惜引蛮族入城。
他抓住魏广和孙哑巴，对他们严刑拷打，询问出密道所在。
魏广死守不说，被折磨了两天两夜。
孙哑巴会读唇语，对赵有财还有大用，对他折磨少一些。
现在魏广已经快不行，进气少出气多。
孙哑巴冒死跑出来，直奔将军府救命。
孙哑巴断断续续把前因后果说了一遍，战承胤面色阴沉可怕，他当即下令，去赵有财窝藏点抓人。
上百名战家军来到藏匿点，已人去楼空。
而魏广躺在地上，浑身是血，各种鞭伤，烫伤，刑具伤痕……
战承胤手指轻触他的鼻息，还有气。
军医宋云辉一起跟来了，给他服下一粒保命药丸，魏广才幽幽睁开眼。
看见战承胤，他想要说什么。
孙哑巴连忙扑过去，耳朵凑近他，在听魏广转述些什么。
只听孙哑巴说：“将军，赵有财知道密道所在了，马上去抓人，或许还来得及。”
地址在镇关往南三十里，一座大山下。
战承胤听言，连忙带人奔去。
他们到达山脚下密道入口，大门已被打开。
田秦点燃一火把，率先带路。
密道是一处天然洞穴，他们沿着洞穴往里走，干枯沙土上能看见一行人凌乱匆忙的脚印。
一个时辰后，他们即将靠近洞穴出口。
出口，有火把光线，战承胤让士兵潜藏在洞石后。
content_en:
There are rumors that there is food in the General's Mansion, and everyone who receives porridge today can get a piece of sweet watermelon.
Zhao Youcai was even more certain that there was a lot of food in the general's mansion!
Wei Guang was a well-known gangster leader in Zhenguan before the barbarian army went south. He had a close friend in the patrol camp.
On Zhenguan Street, he counted people from both the black and white streets.
You don’t have to pay to eat in the store on weekdays.
Some stores with good business take the initiative to pay protection fees to prevent local gangsters from running wild in the store.
Wei Guang will definitely do things after receiving the money. If he doesn't pay for meals, he will have them dragged out and beaten.
Although he is a mess, he is still moral.
The reason why Zhao Youcai must be Wei Guang is because Wei Guang was once wanted by the garrison at the town gate.
He knew the secret passage from Zhenguan to the outside, so he was never caught.
Zhao Youcai wanted to send a message to the outside world, and wanted to lure the barbarians into the town pass through the secret passage, and attack the general's mansion to steal grain...
For the sake of money, he did not care about the lives of the people in the city.
He wanted to rob the general's mansion and have countless wealth in this life, the next life, and for generations to come.
China dried up and the six countries had no harvest.
With this batch of food, he can harvest the wealth of the world.
That's why he was so crazy and didn't hesitate to lure the barbarians into the city.
He caught Wei Guang and Sun Yaba, tortured them, and asked them where the secret passage was.
Wei Guang refused to say anything and was tortured for two days and two nights.
Sun Mute can read lips, which will be of great use to Zhao Youcai and torture him less.
Now Wei Guang is dying, with less air coming in and more air coming out.
Sun Yaba ran out risking his life and went straight to the general's mansion to save his life.
Sun Yaba explained the cause and effect intermittently. Zhan Chengyin looked gloomy and terrifying. He immediately ordered to arrest Zhao Youcai at his hiding place.
Hundreds of Zhan Jiajun came to the hiding place, but the building was empty.
And Wei Guang was lying on the ground, covered in blood, with various whip wounds, burns, torture instrument scars...
Zhan Chengyin touched his nose lightly with his fingers, and he was still breathing.
Military doctor Song Yunhui followed him and gave him a life-saving pill before Wei Guang opened his eyes quietly.
Seeing Zhan Chengyin, he wanted to say something.
Sun Mute hurriedly rushed towards him and put his ear close to him, listening to what Wei Guang was relaying.
I only heard Sun Dumb say: "General, Zhao Youcai knows where the secret passage is. Go and arrest him immediately. Maybe it's still too late."
The address is thirty miles south of Zhenguan, at the foot of a big mountain.
After Zhan Chengyin heard this, he quickly led his people to run.
They arrived at the entrance to the secret passage at the foot of the mountain, and the door was opened.
Tian Qin lit a torch and took the lead in leading the way.
The secret passage was a natural cave. As they walked along the cave, they could see the messy and hurried footprints of a group of people on the dry sand.
An hour later, they were approaching the cave exit.
There was a torch light at the exit, and Zhan Chengyin asked the soldiers to hide behind the cave stone.
title_en: Chapter 23: The army is approaching Chapter 24: The siege begins
